purpose: Collect search terms in a purpose-built field with a leading search icon and contextual clear action.

notes: Use VeliProvider for localized placeholder and clear-button labels and RTL behavior.

useWhen: Users need to enter a query that filters or searches content.
The query should expose a one-action clear control when populated.

avoidWhen.situation: Users must search a finite option list and select a value.

supportedInteractions: Clear the current value and restore input focus
Focus by clicking the field shell
approvedPatterns: Always provide an accessible name through page labeling or aria-label.
Use description text normally and errorMessage when invalid.
limitations: No visible label is rendered by the component.
The clear button is hidden for empty, disabled, or read-only fields.
Direct child composition, style overrides, and changing the input type are not supported.
accessibility: Uses a native search input through React Aria TextField.
The clear action has a localized accessible label and returns focus to the input.
Disabled, read-only, and invalid states are exposed through React Aria.
responsive: The field fills its container; set width through surrounding layout or root className.
rtl: The field layout mirrors with the active direction and search terms follow standard input direction behavior.
